lead: Plug Power / PLUG — The hydrogen dream runs short of cash
smaller: Short Treasuries / SHY — T-bill and chill becomes a strategy
Aerospace & Defense ETF / ITA — Buying the war trade with a guilty conscience
Solana / SOL-USD — The altcoin crowd chases the next leg
why_lead: Plug Power had the session's largest move (-40.47% to 3.53 USD; -51.91% over 20 sessions) on a newly published stability concern from its financial filing (n0930), inside a sector Barron's says has collapsed (n0816) with Enphase, SolarEdge and NuScale down 37% to 64% over 20 sessions. Simple, repeatable crowd story (the hydrogen lottery ticket meets a cash problem) with rates as the mechanism (2Y +21 bps over five observations). Attention is shown by post-mortem coverage (n0816, n1879, n1856, n0072) and the crowd's pivot to cash (n1738); smart-money split between policy ambition (n1864) and incumbents capturing hydrogen demand (n0262).
why_smaller: Short Treasuries / SHY: newly published T-bill-and-chill and record money-fund coverage (n1738, n1349) with a 5.53% three-month yield; Moody's negative outlook and shutdown risk (n2051, n1411) plus opportunity cost supply the break. A cash-as-the-trade narrative, distinct from the 2023-11-02 long-bond TLT item.

Aerospace & Defense ETF / ITA: CNBC's guilty-defense-buyer story (n1757) is direct investor-psychology evidence, with ITA +4.88% and RTX +12.25% over 20 sessions and new orders (n1746, n1482); uneven gains and stopgap-funding risk (n1414) supply the break.

Solana: +30.31% over five days and +76.30% over 20 sessions with newly published coverage of the break above $60 (n1013) and the post-FTX industry moving on (n1011); its borrowed ETF case (n0997, n0664) supplies the break. Last featured 2023-11-02; a higher-beta altcoin narrative, distinct from the 2023-11-10 ether ETF lead.

considered_not_chosen.reason: SOXL +12.02% and TSM +6.35% with Nvidia's China-compliant chip report (n1241), but AI and chips led on 2023-11-02 and 2023-11-07 and the move is a one-session rebound.
Wegovy heart-risk results (n1874) are newly published, but the weight-loss theme led on 2023-11-03 and 2023-11-09 and NVO moved only +1.16%.
HSBC reduce rating and Ron Baron's $25,000-car comment (n1744, n0891) are new but incremental to the 2023-11-06 Tesla item; +2.22% session.
Featured on 2023-11-01, 2023-11-09 and 2023-11-10; a further -8.04% session without a newly published catalyst, so not repeated.
-8.17% on a quarterly loss tied to WeWork (n0880, n0762), an institutional write-down story without retail-attention evidence.
Lead on 2023-11-10; -0.37% with no newly published catalyst, used only as context in the Solana item.

selection_memory.lead_material_change: Plug Power (PLUG) is a new lead ticker. The clean-energy distress theme appeared only as smaller items (SolarEdge 2023-11-02, NuScale 2023-11-10); it is promoted on newly published evidence: Plug's stability concern (n0930, published 2023-11-11), Barron's sector-collapse piece (n0816) and the WSJ and Koch coverage (n1879, n1856), plus a 40.47% one-day move. Solana returns as a smaller item for the first time since 2023-11-02 on new evidence (n1013, n1011) and a much larger move; ether (lead 2023-11-10) is context only.
